en-US: Build 224 fixes Build 223 Runtime v2 startup and migration: fresh registries and older Linux installs open again, verified content is never misreported as uninstalled, and environments needing repair fail closed. It keeps the on-device MLX model resident across retained-task idle gaps so later tool turns no longer reinitialize the container. PPT/PPTX editing now reaches its first editable render instead of staying on opening. Linux image download stays GitHub-first and uses the sharded Gitee mirror only after a bounded primary failure, with every piece and the whole archive hash-verified and resumable. Please retest opening an existing Linux install, environment migration/repair, package persistence, local-model multi-turn tools with long gaps, PPT edit/save/reopen, and the download path on a slow or interrupted network. Cloud build, upload, Apple processing and TestFlight availability are not yet complete.
zh-Hans: Build 224 修复 Build 223 Runtime v2 的启动与迁移：全新注册表和旧 Linux 安装都能再次启动，已验证内容不会被误报为未安装，需要修复的环境会安全中止。设备端 MLX 模型在任务保留的空闲间隙保持驻留，后续工具轮次不再重新初始化容器。PPT/PPTX 编辑现在能进入首个可编辑渲染，不再一直停在“打开中”。Linux 镜像下载保持 GitHub 优先，仅在主源出现有界失败后才使用分片 Gitee 镜像，每个分片和整包都做哈希校验且可断点续传。请重点复测打开已有 Linux、环境迁移/修复、软件包持久化、长间隔下本地模型多轮工具、PPT 编辑保存重开，以及慢速或中断网络下的下载路径。云端构建、上传、Apple 处理与 TestFlight 可用性尚未完成。
